column1: # Edge groups of the marketing module's crawler job (ARGUS_GOOGLEBOT_EDGES_FILE, default <volume>/etc/googlebot-edges.tsv).
# label <TAB> parser <TAB> LogQL stream selector [<TAB> site host, for a cache group]
#   json   nginx access log with escape=json and the fields remote_addr, status, request_time, body_bytes_sent,
#   cache  a cache edge's short JSON log with ip, s, rt, b, c (cache status), u (URI), ua; it serves one site host
# The first group is the primary one: an hour counts for the detector once every bucket of it is stored.
